title: Shard Dominion
description: Late-90s C&C/Red-Alert-style RTS on Aether Prime. NEW Story Mode: a title menu + a scripted campaign (Mission 1 'First Light' — the Meridian Concord vs the Emberhand) alongside classic Skirmish vs a goal-driven AI that runs its own economy. Harvest Shard, build a base, command an army.
